themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform complex research tasks autonomously or collaboratively, focusing on discovery, strategy, and advanced tool integration.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including code generation, review, and security aspects.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses articles about platforms and software that leverage AI to enhance various aspects of user research, from participant management to insight generation.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Includes discussions on AI chatbots and conversational agents used for user interaction, data collection, and generating insights, with a focus on their impact and potential pitfalls.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications directly impacting the design and research process, including UI generation, content transformation, and adaptive UI design.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating and improving the process of testing product usability and accessibility across various platforms.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to extract, analyze, and leverage insights from customer data to improve user experience and product development.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the recruitment process, including research into job markets, candidate sourcing, and the impact on employers and jobseekers.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing, research, and understanding AI behavior in various contexts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's capability to condense large amounts of information, such as research findings or documents, into concise summaries for faster understanding.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
